raw_summaries.claude_code: 3 active projects, 2 in maintenance. Autonomy is high on the automated pipeline (runs fully unattended), medium on the portfolio (collaborative), low on the habit tracker (directing each step). Two automation workflows: daily brief cron and morning sync. Yegge estimate: 5.5 — solid agentic usage but no formal multi-agent coordination yet.
raw_summaries.other_ai_tools: ChatGPT used ad hoc for exploratory research and first drafts. Zapier newsletter digest runs weekly. No other AI platforms in active use. Automation complexity: low (single-step triggers, no multi-step conditional logic).
raw_summaries.claude_ai_notes: Noticed I tend to accept Claude.ai prose outputs more readily than code outputs — less likely to push back or revise. Used AI heavily for planning tasks (architecture decisions, project scoping) this quarter, which felt like a good use. Started prompts vaguely when exploring new problem spaces, then refined after first output. Meta-conversation: spent one session just asking Claude how to improve my prompting for a specific domain.
